trace.final_message:
I added the gaps module and its tests, and committed them on `master`. Nothing is pushed.

- **`hourglass/gaps.py`**
  - `uncovered_spans(worked, opening)` returns the uncovered stretches as `Span` values, in time order.
  - `find_gaps(worked, opening)` returns one text label per stretch, in the form `gap start-end (minutes min)`.
  - If any worked span falls outside opening hours, both functions raise `ValueError`.
  - Overlapping and unordered input is fine, because the worked spans are merged first.
- **`tests/test_gaps.py`**: ten tests covering no shifts, full cover, gaps in the middle and at both ends, overlapping input, the label text, and the outside-hours error.

`make check` runs thirty-six tests, and all pass. `make lint` reports no syntax errors.

Choices I made:
- I used `ValueError` rather than `ProjectError`, since `ProjectError` is for unusable schedule files.
- Opening hours is a single `Span`, so the caller passes the day's bounds in directly.
- I left out the export in `hourglass/__init__.py`, the entry in `docs/api.txt`, and the line in `CHANGES.txt`. I can add any of them if you want.
- I put the `# ---` comment above the test methods too, since they are public by name. I can drop that on the tests if you prefer.
- The helper functions are private, so they have no `# ---` comment.

The existing modules in the repo don't all follow the project rules, for example some lines run past sixty characters. I did not touch them.

commits.message:
Add gaps module for uncovered opening hours

find_gaps returns one label per stretch of opening hours that no worked span covers. A worked span outside opening hours raises ValueError.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
